lines: If an earthquake hits your home at night, do not run outside into the dark.
The ground beneath Mark shakes violently, and the walls begin to groan and crack loudly.
Falling objects and debris near buildings cause most injuries during sudden structural movement events.
Mark stays completely away from windows, glass, and tall furniture that might fall.
One. Drop to your hands and knees immediately before the violent shaking knocks you down.
Two. Cover your head and neck securely under a sturdy wooden table right beside you.
Three. Hold on tightly to the furniture legs while the violent tremor shakes the house.
After the violent shaking stops completely, Mark must expect dangerous aftershocks very soon.
He carefully checks the air around him for any strong gas smell in the room.
He remembers to leave the building immediately if he smells leaking gas anywhere nearby.
The heavy tremors finally fade away, leaving a strange and heavy silence in the dark.
Mark stands up slowly and breathes out a long breath of pure relief tonight.
He checks his phone for any emergency alerts, but the screen stays completely dark.
It was the perfect survival plan executed with absolute calm and total precision.
There was just one unexpected problem waiting for him outside the front door.
part1.cliffhanger: The front door is completely jammed shut by fallen structural debris, trapping him inside.
